summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its individual and consolidated quarterly financial information for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings report in the ordinary course of business, containing standard financial statements, notes, and management commentary. There are no references to any special-situation corporate event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other event-driven activity. The registrant's role is the issuer of its own quarterly report. As an SEC filing under Rule 13a-16 / 15d-16, it serves as the equivalent of an annual or quarterly report for a foreign private issuer. The document is purely informational and does not trigger any special situation classification.
